 Russell Brand’s bizarre admission about Katy Perry marriage and vile genitalia comments laid bare in newly unsealed court docs 
 By 
 Jolie Zenna 
 Published 
 Nov. 20, 2026, 4:25 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Russell Brand couldn’t remember when he was married to Katy Perry during a deposition last year.
 In the unsealed court docs, obtained by the Daily Mail , the disgraced comedian was asked about an incident in which an anonymous victim claimed he exposed himself to her while filming his 2011 film “Arthur” and later assaulted her in a bathroom.
 Based on transcripts of the deposition, filed with the New York Supreme Court, the British actor, 51, was unable to recall the exact timeline of his and Perry’s relationship when asked if he was married at the time the movie was filmed.
 12

 12 
 At the time, officials questioned the disgraced actor because a woman accused him of assaulting her while filming his 2011 film “Arthur” (a scene from which is seen above). Â©Warner Bros/Courtesy Everett Collection

 “Whilst I — of course, it wouldn’t be difficult for me to find out whether or not I was married, because it would be on the internet somewhere, I’m assuming,” he told officials. “I was — what I do know is that I was in a relationship with, as you know, obviously a very high-profile woman. And even when I was married to her, I was sort of drowning in love.”
 Perry and Brand, notably, met in 2009 while the pop star filmed a cameo for the actor’s movie “Get Him to the Greek” and began dating later that same year.
 12 
 Brand was unable to recall if he and Perry (pictured together at the “Arthur” premiere) were married at the time the movie was filmed. Getty Images 
 12 
 “What I do know is that I was in a relationship with, as you know, obviously a very high-profile woman. And even when I was married to her, I was sort of drowning in love,” he said in the newly unsealed court docs. WireImage 
 They tied the knot in October 2010 in India, but separated by the end of the following year. Their divorce was finalized in 2012.
 Brand’s alleged victim claimed he exposed himself to her in July 2010, three months before he and Perry got married.
 Any mention of their union or the “Teenage Dream” singer was  blocked from being mentioned during Brand’s recent rape trial.
 12 
 Perry and Brand met in 2009 on the set of the movie “Get Him to the Greek.” (The former pair is pictured above at the film’s 2010 premiere.) FilmMagic 
 12 
 The duo, pictured above in January 2010, got married in October of that year in India, but separated by the end of the following year. BACKGRID 
 More transcripts of the deposition also show a bizarre exchange in which Brand confirmed he had referred to his penis as “willy.”
 “That’s normal in England,” he insisted. “That’s a standard innocuous and — I would say deliberately and overtly nonsexual. That’s the way you would refer to your child’s penis.”
 When asked if he had ever asked anyone to “kiss his willy,” he gave a strange lecture on “asexual genitalia.”
 12 
 Other transcriptions from the deposition show Brand (pictured above in 2009) explaining why he refers to his penis as his “willy.” Getty Images 
 12 
 “That’s normal in England,” the actor (pictured above in 2014) insisted. “That’s a standard innocuous.” Brian J Ritchie/Hot Sauce / Shutterstock 
 “I don’t like that idea, no, because — because I don’t like the conflation of an erotic request with the lexicon of asexual genitalia,” he said.
 He continued, “The word ‘willy’ is to strip it of its phallic potency, and the request to kiss it is to embolden that.”
 As for the claims that he assaulted Jane Doe, Brand insisted any sexual encounters were consensual, though he couldn’t recall if he exposed himself to the woman.
 12 
 The bizarre revelations come on the heels of Brand’s rape trial. ZUMAPRESS.com 
 12 
 Brand (pictured above with his wife, Laura Gallacher) was convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault and sentenced to a total of 10 years and six months in prison. REUTERS

 “I couldn’t concretely and absolutely rule that out,” he confessed, noting that he finds the idea that he did so “quite embarrassing.”
 The shock revelations come weeks after Brand was convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault — and sentenced to a total of 10 years and six months in prison.
 His conviction stems from incidents in the 2000s. Throughout the nearly four-week trial, he adamantly denied any wrongdoing.
 12 
 Brand has maintained his innocence and released a statement from prison via his wife (pictured above arriving at court earlier this month). Steve Wood/Shutterstock 
 12 
 Since Brand (pictured above in 2009) was convicted, six more alleged victims have come forward. SWNS 
 The “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” actor was transferred to HMP Littlehey in Cambridgeshire, England , on Nov. 13, which primarily holds around 1,200 male sex offenders.
 In a statement written behind bars and read by his wife, Laura Gallacher, Brand pleaded his innocence. The message is now being “urgently investigated” and he is reportedly facing punishment for it .
 Following Brand’s conviction, six additional women accused him of sexual misconduct , with the alleged incidents occurring around the same time as the misconduct he was convicted of.
